title: How to Use Dictation on Mac (Built-In + AI)
description:
How to use dictation on Mac with Apple’s built-in Dictation and AI Dictation.
Download AI Dictation: https://aidictation.com/download?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=how_to_use_dictation_on_mac

Apple’s built-in option: turn on Dictation in System Settings → Keyboard, place the cursor in a text field, then use the Microphone key, your chosen shortcut, or Edit → Start Dictation.

AI Dictation adds a configurable global shortcut, local recognition on supported Macs and languages, optional cloud transcription and cleanup, personal vocabulary, replacements, writing rules, and spoken shortcuts.

AI Dictation is open source: https://github.com/writingmate/aidictation
Apple’s current Mac Dictation guide: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/use-dictation-mh40584/mac
